newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan soldiers charged with murder of Tamils.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan soldiers charged with murder of Tamils.

text.p: A Sri Lankan court has charged eight soldiers with the murder of 25 Tamil civilians, including women and children, in eastern Trincomalee a year ago, court officials said on Thursday.

Magistrate S.A. Liyanage also charged the soldiers with the attempted murder of 26 civilians who were wounded when the troops went on the rampage in the village of Kumarapuram, on February 11, 1996, they said.

Military officials said the troops had apparently shot dead the civilians in retaliation for the killing of two soldiers by the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels near Kumarapuram, 30 km (19 miles) south of Trincomalee, the same day.
The LTTE are fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in the Indian Ocean island's north and east.
The government, which has cracked down on human rights abuses by its security forces, ordered an inquiry into the massacre after complaints by Tamil parliamentarians.
Court officials said three of the 120 witnesses to the massacre gave evidence when the case was heard on Wednesday.
The next hearing is scheduled for April 2.
The government says more than 50,000 people have died in the war, now in its 14th year. The LTTE says the toll is higher.
